selection_rule.tie_break: fewer canonical relations; then profile name

statistics.single_seed_aggregation: equal-fold mean and sample standard deviation
statistics.multiple_seed_aggregation: mean folds within seed, then mean and sample standard deviation across seeds
statistics.pair_unit: fold for one seed; (fold, seed) for multiple seeds

node_wilcoxon.all_zero: statistic n*(n+1)/4; p=1; no normal approximation needed

statistics.a12: all cross-distribution pairs: P(profile > baseline) + 0.5*P(tie); not paired win fraction

holm.interim: raw p only; adjustment pending until full four-comparison family

statistics.interpretation: folds share training data; intervals are descriptive, not independent-seed or causal evidence

numerical_proof.parameter_copy: Every G0 parameter identical; added empty relation rows zero/priority1
numerical_proof.limitation: At a fixed layer input, only message mean denominator changes. With stacked layers, nonlinear hidden states and attention can then change; final logits are not a constant scalar multiple.

G0P.comparison: G0P-G0 separately for node tasks; excluded from old four-comparison Holm family

execution_policy: serial fresh process; stop on any failed fit; no automatic retry
primary_endpoint: L-audit best outer_test HCG node/file; reentrancy_node G3R-G0
final_server_intent: Final experiments planned on sufficient-VRAM server; current local limitation is not a final model restriction.
